---
title: updatethis
output: gfm
---

A tiny CLI to programmatically update the version of an R package.

## Installation

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/JosiahParry/updatethis --tag v0.1.0
```

## Usage

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
cat(system("updatethis --help", intern = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```

### Increment the package version

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| comment: ""
cat(system("updatethis version --help", intern = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```
